name: arch-forge
description: Requirement-driven architecture workflow for new Go / PHP / Rust projects: interview, architecture options from monolith to microservices with framework and library selection, ADR, then scaffolding and build verification. Rules and hooks keep the dependency rules afterwards.

hook_profile.title: Hook profile
hook_profile.description: minimal: only injects the confirmed architecture at session start. standard: also asks before editing accepted ADRs and warns about dependency-direction violations in edited files. strict: turns warnings into blocks and runs arch-lint before stopping. off: disables the hooks.
